messages:
elaine_sales: FYI Acme POC blocked — their Okta SSO attempt fails and SCIM provisioning returns 403. They said Dedicated pool + VPC is ready but users not showing up. Can someone triage?

ben_se: Can you paste the exact SAML assertion snippet or a SAML tracer capture? Common causes: Audience URI mismatch or NameID format. Also confirm if they uploaded our metadata or the other way around.

elaine_sales: Sent a short SAML trace in thread (private screenshot posted). Their assertion Audience looks like `https://acme.subdomain` while our expected Audience is `https://redwood-inference/acs`.

maria_solutions: SCIM 403 usually means the Okta provisioning service account token lacks the right privileges or the SCIM base URL is wrong. Verify Okta -> Provisioning -> API Integration settings: token present, "Enable API Integration" checked, and the Base URL set to our tenant's SCIM endpoint `/scim/v2/`.

ben_se: Quick troubleshooting checklist:
- Confirm SAML Audience matches exactly (case-sensitive).
- Confirm NameID is `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` if we're mapping email.
- Check certificate expiry in the assertion header (seen this before — expired cert yields immediate fail).

elaine_sales: Acme says they used the metadata we emailed last week. I asked them to re-download metadata after we rotated cert on staging.

maria_solutions: Also: Dedicated environments use tenant-scoped SCIM endpoints. If Acme pointed Okta at the Hosted SCIM URL, requests will 403/404. Need tenant_id (the env id) in the URL: `https://api.redwood.example.com/tenants/<tenant_id>/scim/v2/Users`. Ask them which env they copied.

ben_se: To test SCIM manually, ask them to run: 
```
curl -i -X GET 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" 
  -H "Accept: application/scim+json" 
  "https://api.redwood.example.com/tenants/REPLACE_TENANT_ID/scim/v2/Users"
```
Return 200 + JSON list if token/URL good. 403 means token scope or wrong tenant.

elaine_sales: I posted their Okta provisioning logs — shows 403 for POST to `/scim/v2/Users` and SAML response `Audience mismatch`. Also saw a warning about an expiring SAML cert on our side.

maria_solutions: If cert expired, we should rotate and send updated metadata.xml to Acme. Steps: generate new cert (we can do), update the SAML config in Console -> Tenant -> SSO, then tell Acme to re-import metadata. Quick openssl commands if they want to self-check: `openssl x509 -in cert.pem -noout -dates` to view expiry.

ben_se: Temporary workaround to continue POC: manually create the few required users in the Dedicated env and proceed with feature evals while we fix SSO/SCIM. Also I can stand up a short session with Acme to watch Okta config live.

deploy-bot: POC-12345 ticket updated: added SAML trace and Okta logs; assigned to ben_se & maria_solutions.

elaine_sales: Action items for us: 1) Rotate SAML cert and send metadata to Acme, 2) Confirm tenant_id and correct SCIM base URL, 3) Ask Acme to re-run the `curl` test and paste response, 4) If needed, create users manually for immediate demos. I'll schedule a 30m call with Acme for tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

ben_se: I'll take cert rotation and stay on the call. Maria — can you validate SCIM token scopes and the tenant URL?

maria_solutions: On it. Will also confirm that Dedicated pool networking (VPC allowlist) has our agent IPs. If allowlist blocks, Okta -> Redwood traffic will time out or show 403 depending on proxy.

elaine_sales: Thanks team — I'll send the call invite and add the screenshots and curl output when they post.
